coverage_assessment: Captured 9 actual English- and Arabic-language search actions with 233 ordered result headers, including full-month and weekly windows plus local, regional, international, official, and rights-related queries. 1 current-unit body opens; 1 prior-unit-only consultations. One Kuwait Times article was read in full as a 164-line rendered page; a prior-unit scoped read for the planned sit-in was consulted without rereading. Fifteen of 16 source cards remain search-only, including unresolved Al-Anba and Arab Times leads. This open-web first pass is incomplete, is not LexisNexis-equivalent, and cannot establish absence of protests. Arabic and local archive coverage remain limited; the official baseline and supplemental Coding Procedure are pending. Two provisional records are retained: E001 pending turnout threshold and E002 pending verification that the announced sit-in occurred.
